user.title: Connect directly to your iSS50
user.description: Enter the sensor’s IPv4 address and printed HomeKit code. Home Assistant pairs directly with the sensor; Apple Home is not required. Use port 80 if confirmed for your device, or 0 to search its TCP ports. The sensor must already be on Wi-Fi and available for pairing.

retry.title: Could not pair
retry.description: Check the error below. Continue to enter setup details again. Keep your existing integration entry when troubleshooting an already configured sensor.

reconfigure.title: Update the sensor connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IPv4 address or TCP port using the existing pairing credentials. The new endpoint is authenticated before saving. No new pairing code is needed.

progress.connecting: Finding the local HomeKit endpoint and pairing directly. This can take several minutes. Keep this window open.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid IPv4 address and an eight-digit HomeKit code.
error.cannot_pair: Could not establish a direct HomeKit pairing. The endpoint may be blocked, already paired, or the code may be incorrect.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the sensor’s HomeKit endpoint. Check its IP address, port, and network access from Home Assistant.
error.already_paired: The sensor rejected a new pairing or has no pairing slots available. It may already belong to another controller. Reload or reconfigure an existing HA entry instead of pairing again.
error.authentication_failed: Authentication failed. For a new pairing, check the printed code. When reconfiguring, the saved keys must match this sensor.
error.pairing_busy: The sensor is busy or limiting pairing attempts. Stop other setup attempts and wait before retrying.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid IPv4 address and a port between 1 and 65535.

init.title: Sound detection
init.description: Automatic uses a clearly labelled sound field reported by the sensor. If your firmware leaves it unnamed, select its sound-detection field here. This reloads the integration using its existing pairing; no pairing code is needed. Sensitivity controls and sound levels are not sound-detection states.

error.invalid_sound_mapping: Choose an available sound source and a detected value of 0 or 1.

abort.not_loaded: The sensor must be connected before configuring sound detection. Restore its connection and reload this integration, then try again.
